title: Tiny joys of making
intro: Making something small, even for two minutes, can be a nice change from a screen. Pick one idea.

cards.front: Fold a paper boat or plane
cards.back: Any scrap of paper will do. It does not have to float or fly.
Draw one shape and repeat it, nudging it each time. Stop when it feels finished.
Use a shoelace, a string or a loose cable. Aim for tidy rather than fancy.

cards.front: Rearrange three things on your desk
cards.back: Make a small arrangement that pleases you and leave it there.
Just one friendly line you will see tomorrow, such as a reminder to enjoy lunch.
A picture, a pile of books or a crooked stack of paper. A small repair is satisfying.
Draw the outline of your mug, a plant or a pen. A rough shape is fine.

cards.front: Roll a ball from scrap paper
cards.back: Scrunch it in your hands and feel how the paper changes. Recycle it afterwards.
A function, a note, a sandwich or a plan all count. Say what it is in a few words.

cards.front: Make a tiny list of three
cards.back: Three things for the weekend, three tunes, or three plants you like.
